fieldNotes.IDENTITY_MISMATCH: CRITICAL: The address 3346 Democrat Drive, Memphis TN 38118 belongs to 'KenCo Distributors Inc' - an unrelated Nashville-based building-materials wholesaler (drywall, insulation, steel framing, flooring; ~7:30am-4:30pm operation). This is NOT 'Kenco Logistics Services' / Kenco Group, the 3PL being audited in this roster. Kenco Group's official warehousing map (kencogroup.com/warehousing-map) lists NO Memphis facility - only Chattanooga TN (already covered as roster idx 16-18). The roster's idx 30 was derived from a Manta/Yellow Pages 'Kenco Logistic Service Memphis' listing that conflated the two companies by name similarity. This roster entry is most likely a name-collision error; Kenco Logistics Services probably has no Memphis DC. The classification below describes the physical building actually at the locked coordinates (the KenCo Distributors warehouse) so the audit is still complete, but it should NOT be treated as a Kenco Logistics Services site. confidence=low.
fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (35.070065,-89.952907, geocode ROOFTOP) land on a long multi-tenant warehouse at 3346 Democrat Drive, Memphis TN. The building is real and is a distribution warehouse, but its occupant is KenCo Distributors (building materials), not the 3PL. Audited the physical building at 35.07060,-89.95290.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or guard booth visible at the driveways off Democrat Rd or at the truck-court drive aisles. Street View (Nov 2025) shows open driveways and an open paved dock court. truckGate=false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth. guardShack=false, remoteGs=false (no gate).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door bank with dock canopies/levelers along the SW face of the long multi-tenant warehouse; ~12 trucks/trailers backed in. Counted ~40 doors across the building face; banded 25-50. Multi-tenant building - KenCo Distributors occupies only a portion. Low-confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Open paved truck court along the SW face holds ~12 trailers; 10-25 band. dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: The locked site comprises the long primary warehouse plus a separate large building immediately to the SW that shares the truck court; counted 2. multipleFacilities left false since these are separate parcels/tenancies rather than one campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs immediately along the NE side of the long warehouse; no clearly visible active spur into the footprint, but rail is adjacent. railServed=true tentatively; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Truck court along the SW dock face is long and open - holds 3+ trucks. postGateStaging=true.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: The site sits at a busy multi-lane intersection (Democrat Rd), but the dock court is set well back with ample internal stacking room, so backupSensitive=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Memphis industrial district near Lamar Ave / Democrat Rd - Urban.
